provenance_limits: Final results CSV/JSON files and manually extracted log text are available; full final generating scripts, genotype matrix, BayPass raw XtX/POD files and original final TreeMix outputs cannot be traced from this local bundle.
Available v2 and server_snapshot scripts contain earlier code. Their absence of claimed final corrections does not prove the remote final run lacked those fixes.
Final p/q values and AAT1 q=0.0049 cannot be independently recomputed from available local raw data. Available per-SNP data describe the old 3,359-SNP run.
Manifest matches verify integrity against the supplied manifest, not remote origin or biological/statistical validity.
Later corrected workspace outputs address several unperformed analyses in the requested Downloads manuscript; their generating step12/step13 scripts are absent.
scope: Read-only local inventories, hashes, text markers and arithmetic. No remote connection, pipeline execution, input mutation or manuscript substitution.
